environment.productionTypes: official @cocos/creator-types@3.8.8 engine declarations; local ignored temp/declarations link

fullTests.failureReason: Historical real Cocos first/second hint-click cards differ from the upgraded recommendation. Existing captured evidence and its assertions were preserved.
fullTests.interpretation: Not an all-green release. Pure recomputation does not validate a new Cocos build or real UI clicks.

typecheck.productionStrictGate: passed within full test run using official Creator 3.8.8 types

legacyArena.scope: hard/normal/simple 200 seeds each; self/crippled 20 each; baseline=legacy, fixedBid=none, seedBase=0. Existing point-estimate gates passed; not incremental strength over R4.

weightsOnlyArena.scope: hard 200 seeds vs legacy and self 20 seeds. Existing point-estimate gate passed; win-difference CI lower bound is zero, so this is not a significant-gain claim.

r4Increment.scope: fixed frozen R4 hard bidding, seeds 100001..100200, three target seats, mirrored opponents; 1200 games. Farmer mirror swaps both partner and landlord. Not an isolated individual-agent effect.
r4Increment.verdict: No significant improvement detected; not an equivalence or non-inferiority proof.

reproduction.note: Exact executed experiment source is archived, not part of the runtime. Adjust its two absolute source roots when replaying elsewhere. Candidate manifest records the pre-commit HEAD and hashes the modified working tree. Reruns after commit naturally have different provenance HEAD.

latency.interpretation: Serial server measurement against fixed corpus; no mobile-performance or before/after speedup claim.

publishToolingTests.note: Process-local default branch is required by the existing test fixture; no repository/global git configuration changed.

remainingReleaseChecks: Cocos Creator 3.8.8 cold build web-mobile from candidate source.
Serve repository root at http://127.0.0.1:7788 and run the existing coordination/scripts/w-audit-hint-probe.mjs following its dependency/setup instructions.
Review fresh real-click evidence and rerun hint-runtime-capture plus the full suite.
Measure latency on target mobile devices before claiming mobile performance.
releaseDecision: Push feature branch and open draft PR. Do not merge or declare a validated release while the real Cocos capture gate remains unresolved.
